newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen moving mostly sideways.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen moving mostly sideways.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LONDON, APRIL 21 (REUTER) - LIFFE July cocoa was seen trading mostly sideways to slightly higher on Monday, and analysts expected it have difficulty making headway on the upside.
Susan Rigg at Chart Analysis said cocoa was liable to range sideways with a small chance of moving higher, but strength would be limited as the market laboured on the upside."
July cocoa was called to open unchanged after closing lower in London and well off session highs in New York on Friday.
Rigg said cocoa futures had a rocky day on Friday and saw the uptrend slowing.
She said major July cocoa support rested at the April 9 low of 980 stg.
Some traders said a break of 987 would be enough to turn the market lower, while a break of 980 might lure funds into setting new short positions.

On Friday exporters and crop analysts in San Pedro said arrivals by April 14 at Ivorian ports for the main crop (Oct-Apr) totalled 970-980,000 tonnes, near the 1995/96 main crop record of just more than a million tonnes.
Funds were expected to start buying if July closed in on its April 2 peak of 1,065. If July get through that, fund buying might push the contract sharply higher.
